summary: Initializes two socket address structures: the first at byte offsets 0x0 (family word set to 2, i.e. AF_INET), 0x2 (port set to 0 via htons), 0x4 (IP dword set to 0 via htonl); the second at byte offsets 0x10 (family word set to 2), 0x12 (port set to 0 via htons), 0x14 (IP dword set to 0 via htonl). All values use network byte order. Called by SocketAddressInitialization (0x0057B8C0). Returns the htons(0) port value (0).

operations.description: Set the first address-family word at this+0x0 to 2 (AF_INET).
Set the first port word at this+0x2 to htons(0) via the htons import.
Set the first IP dword at this+0x4 to htonl(0) via the htonl import.
Set the second address-family word at this+0x10 to 2 (AF_INET).
Set the second port word at this+0x12 to htons(0) via the htons import.
Set the second IP dword at this+0x14 to htonl(0) via the htonl import.
